## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle *jātaka* / *avadāna* on the doctrine of *karmic* transmigration through three previous-life states, framed as a Buddha-discourse at Jetavana to an assembly of five hundred *bhikṣu*-arhats. Translated by [法炬](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%82%AC) Fǎjù (\*Dharma-bhāṇaka), a Western-Jìn translator. Signature (with Taishō apparatus glosses): 「西晉沙門法炬譯」.

**Abstract**

T178 is one of Fǎjù's documented Western-Jìn translations from the late third / early fourth century; Fǎjù's recorded translation period is c. 290–307 CE at Luòyáng. The Indic source is unidentified; the *jātaka* is a relatively short *karmic*-illustration narrative rather than a formally-named *avadāna* of the standard collections.
